cases.title: 1983 Oilers trade down twice: Dickerson, Warner and Matthews
cases.description: A two-trade draft-capital exchange, not one pick transformed into three players.
questions: Which team selected Dickerson and at what number?
How did Houston obtain Matthews, Bostic and Dressel?
Were the Rams fourth-round choices part of the separate Seattle deal?

stages.text: Houston sent its 1983 No. 2 to the Rams and received No. 3 plus 1983 and 1984 fourth-round selections.
Houston moved the acquired No. 3 to Seattle for Nos. 9, 42 and 69. Those three selections are the return of a second transaction, not three outcomes of the No. 2 pick.
Los Angeles used No. 2 on Eric Dickerson; Seattle used No. 3 on Curt Warner; Houston used Nos. 9, 42 and 69 on Bruce Matthews, Keith Bostic and Chris Dressel.

limitations: The two original fourth-rounders are separate branches, not included in this scoped first-round chain.
Sources establish announced trades and draft selections, not an exhaustive accounting of later player trades.
Do not assign the value of all three Houston selections to the original No. 2 pick alone.

cases.title: 2016 Goff package: Henry, Johnson and the Conklin trade-up
cases.description: The original draft assets and the later Cleveland package must be separated.
questions: How did the Titans acquire the picks used on Henry and Johnson?
Which extra original Tennessee pick helped fund the Conklin trade-up?
Who selected the players taken at Nos. 15 and 76?
Which separate 2017 selections came from Los Angeles?

stages.text: Los Angeles acquired 2016 Nos. 1, 113 and 177 from Tennessee; Tennessee received 2016 Nos. 15, 43, 45 and 76 plus the Rams 2017 first- and third-round choices.
Tennessee sent the acquired Nos. 15 and 76 and its separate 2017 second-rounder to Cleveland for Nos. 8 and 176. The extra second-rounder was not an incoming Rams asset.

The Rams selected Jared Goff at No. 1. Tennessee selected Jack Conklin at No. 8, Austin Johnson at No. 43 and Derrick Henry at No. 45. Cleveland selected Corey Coleman at No. 15 and Shon Coleman at No. 76.
Tennessee used the Rams-origin first and third at Nos. 5 and 100 on Corey Davis and Jonnu Smith. These are different assets from the separate 2017 second surrendered in the Conklin package.

limitations: The Titans and Rams transaction ledgers list Apr 13, whereas the contemporary public announcement is Apr 14; the Titans/Browns transaction ledgers list Apr 27, whereas the contemporary draft-day selection is Apr 28. Keep canonical dates unchanged and distinguish announcement from ledger dates.
The later No. 176 package and the Rams subsequent No. 113 and 177 outcomes lie outside this scoped reader. No full package value is assigned to the original No. 1 alone.
The current repository classifies the Cleveland downstream route as factual archive and non-index-eligible; no internal link is rendered to it.

sourceScope: Retained 18-case model unchanged; separate two NFL cases with first-party stage evidence. No install authorization or source epoch substitution.
